thread:
aisha: Quick status: Foxglove week0 private onboarding. Hit two blocking items: 1) cross-account VPC peering route not propagating, 2) KMS key policy needs principal from their service account. Also noted audit logs aren't arriving to their SIEM.

dan: copying the network team — which peering? is this the prod-priv <-> redwood-transit?

aisha: yes prod-priv <-> rwd-transit in us-west-2. Route table shows the peering but traffic drops. traceroute from their jumpbox times out after first hop.

mark-sre: can you paste the peering status + peering connection id? I'll run a quick VPC Flow Log sniff.

aisha: PCX id pcx-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h

mark-sre: got it. I see the route table has a missing target on one of the private subnets — looks like the route was added to the public RT by mistake. Moving a route entry now.

keith: heads up — if you change the RT, verify the egress nat gw path. Last time a mis-route caused connectivity to S3 for audit logs to break.

mark-sre: good call. I'll validate.

jenna: on KMS: Foxglove provided a key arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01. Their current key policy blocks our service principal rwd-infra-role. They want us to avoid adding a wildcard. Suggested snippet to add:

```
"Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
"Effect": "Allow",
"Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/rwd-infra-role" },
"Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:Encrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
"Resource": "*"
```

jenna: they asked if we can do a temporary canary key instead of granting decrypt on prod key — option for canary?

dan: agree canary is safer. but we need decrypt for backups/restore flow in day1. recommend add the role with a conditional that time-bounds the permission, then rotate.

aisha: noted. I proposed the conditional TTL approach and asked Foxglove ST to approve. Awaiting response.

jenna: also need to confirm CMK grants for CloudTrail integration so audit logs can be encrypted and delivered.

sara_ops: on audit logs — their CloudTrail shows events delivered to a S3 bucket, but nothing forwarded to their SIEM. Their Lambda forwarder is erroring with AccessDenied to decrypt SNS message payload. Looks KMS related.

mark-sre: once key policy allows rwd-infra-role, re-run the forwarding lambda. I can trigger a test event.

keith: for visibility, can we wire temporary debug metrics to the onboarding dashboard? adding a tile for "audit-forwarder errors" would help.

@deploy-bot: scheduled run: invoke-forwarder-test for foxglove at 2024-06-21T15:30:00Z.

aisha: thanks. Also raising a renewal-risk flag: account health shows they used < 20% of committed capacity in last 30 days and we see multiple handoffs. If onboarding drags > 2 weeks, renewal Q3 might be at-risk. Suggest weekly exec sync until signals improve.

dan: agree — tag renewal team and schedule a 30-min alignment with Foxglove CSM & AM. Aisha, can you draft talking points?

aisha: drafting now: 1) current blockers, 2) mitigations + ETA, 3) short-term canary plan, 4) ask for SOC teammate to confirm SIEM schema. Will post before EOD.

jenna: capture the canary plan in the runbook under "kms-temp-canary" so eng can follow. I'll add the snippet and rollback notes.

mark-sre: TL;DR action list: (1) fix route table (done) (2) validate NAT and S3 egress (in progress) (3) request KMS policy approval (pending) (4) run audit forwarder test (scheduled) (5) add dashboard tile (keith) (6) exec sync if not green by Fri.

keith: I'll add the dashboard tile and alert: if forwarder errors >5 in 1h, page oncall.

foxglove-bot (external): "Thanks — reviewing KMS policy proposal; will respond by EOD PT."

aisha: perfect. I'll update the onboarding health tracker and ping renewal in CRM. Putting a note in their runbook: "Week0 hold on audit-forwarding until KMS grant approved".

dan: once Foxglove approves the policy, mark stage=smoke and re-run smoke tests.

jenna: capturing lessons: 1) default guidance doc for customers to include our service principal in their key policy, 2) checklist item to validate route target right after peering through automated RT checks. I'll make PR to enable both.

aisha: thanks team — small followups: can we get an ETA on the forwarder test result? mark?

mark-sre: running now. initial test shows Decrypt success once I applied the fix to route and temporary IAM tweak. Results: audit event forwarded to SIEM test index. Marking as partial green but waiting final KMS policy to be applied by Foxglove before closing.

aisha: great — I'll send an update to Foxglove and book the exec sync for Mon 10am PT.

keith: noted renewal flag in CRM with severity=medium. Will escalate if no progress by Tue. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

aisha: end-of-thread summary: route fix ✅, forwarder test ✅ (partial), KMS policy pending, exec sync scheduled. I'll capture next steps in the runbook. Thanks everyone. :heart:
